answer: Stake reputation, not accounts: each identity deposits escrowed POA that vests only after three epochs of peer-graded work, so a farm pays real cost per head while one honest operator earns trust gradually. Grading splits each agent's record like light through a prism — different peers see different slices, so fake neighbors can't all vouch at once. An orchard of shallow sybils stays cheap to plant but produces no graded history, and its pulse of activity flatlines before the deposit ever vests.
